resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on an update because the number of unique de-duplication candidates exceeded the permitted limit while the applicant was not whitelisted.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted an update and the biometrics matched more records than policy allows an operator to adjudicate for one packet, which usually indicates a low-quality capture matching broadly rather than a real duplicate. With the candidate set over the ceiling the comparison could not be completed and the packet was rejected. A new packet with a careful, high-quality capture of every modality is needed to narrow the candidate set.
